guidance: Choose what demonstrates this particular goal's outcome, not a generic dashboard. Reuse linked routines; distinguish consistency from outcomes. Compose only catalog modules (blocks) with stable ids. Use the client's exact advertised catalog, or one view per catalog when none is advertised, with identical metrics. Save it as a view with views_create, as the last step of the batch_apply that creates the goal, and change it later with views_update. Keep a metric that has recorded observations, in its unit. A metric may name a provider series as its source; otherwise the person records it. The client owns fonts, colour, accessibility and responsive layout. No arbitrary code, queries or generated observations.
